text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, dropping by the classroom... 
Matikanefukukitaru and others were playing 
Kokkuri-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please, oh please, Kokkuri-samaaa! You are 
our only hopeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whereabouts of super important lucky item! 
Show us the waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Fukukitaru. Look, we'll help 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, Kokkuri-san for lost item search... 
Fukukitaru never wavers, huh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well... she's especially panicked today. 
Let's play along until she feels better.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, here we go fair and square...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kokkuri-samaaa! Please come to us, we 
prayyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Answering Matikanefukukitaru's voice, 
10-yen coin slowly began to slide...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eek?! M-My finger slipped off...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You have descended~~! Funnyaka~~! 
Hannyaka~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whereabouts of my precious lucky item, 
please explain, oh great spiriiit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
10-yen coin smoothly glided again... and 
stopped on letter 'E'.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes, it's 
heeeere!! 'E'!! First letter is 'E'!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Meaning, yes, that, um, E, E, E―― 'Egao' 
(Smile)?! Put on a smile?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood, leave it to me, big cheeeese!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, were those the rules? Aren't we 
supposed to wait until it spells a word...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru... Looks like she's panicking 
even more than expected.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Follow your guidance and everything solves 
itself! What's next after smile, 
Kokkuri-samaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Fukukitaru-style 
Kokkuri-san steadily went on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: 'U'!! Undou (Exercise)!! Then, 30 squats!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
'NO'!! Nomimono (Drinks), let's get 
drinks! Clue must be there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
'KI'!! Meaning Kirikabu (Tree stump)! 
Stump points to handkerchief!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhh!! It's nowhere to be fouuund!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should tell her... she's doing it 
wrong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Why don't we just search normally?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My whole academy life hangs on that lucky 
item, Kokkuri-samaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to its divine blessing... I managed 
to make such good friends, waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So without it...!! Eeeeeek, 
Kokkuri-samaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Friendship-boosting lucky item. Learning 
reason behind her fear, friends wore 
complicated expressions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the item, huh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hau?! Both of you have gloomy faces, 
what's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Lot of mixed feelings, but for now, we 
gotta find what's important to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Let's check dorms and cafeteria 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! Blessed with such wonderful friends! 
Truly, truly happiest person alive...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Matikanefukukitaru looked 
straight up into sky――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, up in that tree! Handkerchief 
caught on branch! That's ittt!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh?! No way?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All thanks to wonderful Kokkuri-sama~! 
Praise be~ praise be~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No way, 'E', 'U', 'NO', 'KI' didn't guide 
you at all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? 'E' 'U' 'NO' 'KI'... 'KI' 'NO' 'U' 
'E'... Ki no ue (On the tree)――
